name: background-beams-with-collision

frames.best_why: A falling purple beam and a small spark burst are both visible beside the headline.

tagline: Faint purple beams fall and burst into sparks along a dark panel's floor.
summary: A dark gradient section with thin beams dropping on separate loops. Each beam bursts into a small shower of purple sparks when it reaches the bottom, then starts again.
appearance: A wide, very dark panel with a soft vertical gradient, a white headline and a pink-to-purple second line centred in the middle. Barely visible purple threads fall from the top, and tiny purple sparks gather along the bottom edge.
behaviour: Thin beams drop on separate looping timers; when one reaches the floor it bursts into a small shower of purple sparks and then starts again from the top. The headline does not move.
demo_content: Headline 'What's cooler than Beams?' with the gradient line 'Exploding beams.'
search_phrases: beams that explode on the floor
purple falling lines with spark bursts
neon rain effect on a dark panel
sparks at the bottom of a section
use_when: A dark hero or section wants subtle vertical motion with small impact bursts at the base.
avoid_when: Most of the frames show almost no motion, and the beams are so faint they read as dust.
customise: Pass your headline as children; the parent height and gradient come from className. Beam positions, timings, colours and the spark burst are fixed in the file.
weight_why: Seven thin beam divs on loops plus a short spark burst on impact.

a11y.note: Continuous looping beams and spark bursts with no reduced-motion check; the effect is decorative and silent to assistive tech.

issues: The beams are nearly invisible against the dark panel; frames 1 and 6 show almost no change.
The bright gradient headline is demo copy, not part of the effect.
polish_why: Restrained palette and clean type, but the beams are too faint to notice.
title: Background Beams With Collision
